text: Richard Mille is a privately held Swiss watchmaker founded in 2001; its Ferrari partner page describes it as a pre-eminent player in watchmaking.
short: Richard Mille is a privately held Swiss watchmaker founded in 2001.

source.name: Ferrari – Richard Mille Team Partner page
source.quote: Founded in 2001, RICHARD MILLE quickly established itself as one of the pre-eminent players within the watchmaking industry
